sources.citation: Blench, Roger & Stuart McGill. 2012. The Kainji languages of northwestern and central Nigeria. Circulation draft, May 2012. Cambridge: Kay Williamson Educational Foundation. 369 pp. (sec. 3.5.2 'Hungwəryə [=Ngwoi]' p.14; sec. 4.5.4 'Hungwəryə' pp.34-35, phonology 'adapted from Hackett & Davies [=Davey] (2009)')
sources.note: Nothing. Sec. 4.5.4 gives consonant and vowel inventories (with palatal/labial 'prosodies') and 'Hungwəryə has two level tones, High and Low. Downstep is not reported, but it would be surprising if it was absent.' The words stress/accent do not occur anywhere in the 369-page draft. Second-hand summary of an unpublished SIL sketch.
